items.name: craft-theme
items.title: CraftUI theme
items.description: The design tokens and block-style utilities used by every CraftUI component. Built from themes/craft.css. Sets only craft-prefixed names, so it leaves shadcn/ui's theme alone.

items.name: craft-button
items.title: Button
items.description: An Ore UI-inspired block button with primary, secondary, destructive, outline and ghost variants, a press animation, a loading state and optional icons.

items.name: craft-input
items.title: Input
items.description: A sunken text field for text, password and number values, with an error state and optional icons.

items.name: craft-checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A green block checkbox with checked, unchecked, indeterminate and disabled states.

items.name: craft-switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: The Ore UI toggle: a sliding block over a track marked I when on and O when off.

items.name: craft-slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider with a green fill and a square block thumb, with an optional label and value.

items.name: craft-progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A progress bar with determinate and indeterminate modes, status tones, custom colors and an optional label.

items.name: craft-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Horizontal tabs in the dark Ore UI tab bar style or as a segmented row, with full keyboard navigation.

items.name: craft-panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A layered surface with a header, title, description, actions, content and footer. Works in React Server Components.

items.name: craft-dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal with an Ore UI title bar, a close button, focus management and Escape support.

items.name: craft-tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A blue speech-bubble tooltip with a stepped pointer, configurable placement and delay, for pointer and keyboard users.

items.name: craft-separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A theme-aware horizontal or vertical groove between sections.

items.name: craft-scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable region with block scrollbars, for vertical and horizontal content, reachable by keyboard.

items.name: craft-select
items.title: Select
items.description: Ore UI's dropdown: a light field for forms or a dark one for filters, opening a list of rows split by lines, with groups and keyboard navigation.

items.name: craft-combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A select you can type into to filter its options, for long lists. Styled like the Select list.

items.name: craft-dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions opened from a button, with separators, groups, checkbox and radio items, submenus, and disabled and destructive actions.

items.name: craft-context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click or long press, with nested menus and full keyboard support. Shares its items with Dropdown Menu.

items.name: craft-radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Ore UI's diamond radio buttons, stacked or in a row, with disabled options and labels.

items.name: craft-accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Framed rows that expand to show more, one at a time or several at once.

items.name: craft-toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Notifications in Ore UI's message colors: success, error, warning and information, with actions, dismissal and screen reader announcements.

items.name: craft-popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A framed panel anchored to a trigger, for interactive content such as a short form.

items.name: craft-navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation as a top bar or an Ore UI settings-style sidebar, with selected links and nested panels.

items.name: craft-pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous and next links and page numbers, with the current page in green. Works in React Server Components.

items.name: craft-table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table drawn as Ore UI list rows, with selection, sortable columns, and empty and loading rows. Works in React Server Components.

items.name: craft-badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Ore UI's tags: flat blocks of color for statuses and labels, in six variants. Works in React Server Components.

items.name: craft-spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A pixel loading spinner, and an overlay that covers content while it loads. Works in React Server Components.
